# os-solution — Dataverse Solution Template

identity: OpenStrata.NET.Solution

Short name: os-solution

Primary output: `Solution\\OstrataTemplate.1.Solution.cdsproj`

Parameters

- `publisher-name` (required)
- `publisher-prefix` (required)
- `ostrata-version` (optional)

Usage example

```powershell
dotnet new os-solution -pn "Your Publisher" -pp "yourns"
```
